name: Ven
source:
The Magician of the 13th World / The Great Magician

Once a sickly human, he was selected by Clavie to become the 13th world's Magician, as there had been none. Regaining his vitality after the transformation, he goes from a broody young man into the chipper and mischievous Magician we have today.

He's well-known in his world as a person who loves to play pranks but also guide adventurers on their way. The range of magic he can use is virtually unlimited, giving him the title of the "great" Magician.

Though restricted in how much he's allowed to interact with the world, Ven aims to find the truth behind the MO worlds and the true nature of ether/magic. He does this for the future of the Magicians and humanity, even if it means initial sacrifices will be made.

[From [url=https://toyhou.se/814447.ven]official bio[/url]]
